Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of right shoulder pain and restricted
range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the forces involved in a collision of this type, and
the presenting symptoms are plausible given that history. Over the course of 14 visits, care included physical
examination, a structured rehabilitation program, and activity modification. Treatment followed a typical clinical
progression, with visit frequency decreasing as strength and mobility improved. Imaging and clinical examination
findings clearly confirm the shoulder injury. No prior injury or treatment involving the same body area is konwn to this
provider. Administrative review of two similar billing entries recorded on the same date of service is currently in
progress. Based on the patient's response to care, the provider anticipates continued gradual recovery with a home
exercise program and periodic reassessment as needed.

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.
